the effects of conditioning stimulus intensity on intracortical processes.
the interaction between intracortical processes and the motor system.
the functional significance of intracortical inhibitory and facilitatory mechanisms and how they interact.

LICI and long interval facilitation are differentially affected over different time courses by CS intensity.

the interaction between long-interval facilitatory and inhibitary processes in M1 is complex, and that this complexity is likely to be due to a number of factors including the intensity-duration relationship of LICI.
